sn.jd: （女性の体について）大きな胸と気持ちの良い曲線を持つさま
sn.ed: (of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves

sn.jd: （雌の体について）健康的に太って活発な
sn.ed: (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous

sn.ed: widely distributed evergreen shrubs and trees

sn.ed: the bodily property of being attractively plump and vigorous and (of women) full-bosomed

sn.jd: 成長が遅く、複数の茎が出る大きな常緑低木または小高木
sn.ed: large slow-growing evergreen shrub or small tree with multiple stems
